headline: A 2016 law renames a VA outpatient clinic in Laughlin, Nevada, after Master Chief Petty Officer Jesse Dean.
what_it_does: This law gives a new name to the Department of Veterans Affairs community-based outpatient clinic in Laughlin, Nevada. The clinic will be called the Master Chief Petty Officer Jesse Dean VA Clinic. The bill does not change the clinic's services, staff, hours, or rules for patients.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on September 23, 2016, and took effect when it was signed.
